result.beings_quote: In the following tale, that relating to John Cokeley, we have a good instance of punishment by fairies.
result.summary: John Cokeley is punished by fairies for blocking a passage, leading to his illness and eventual replacement by a fairy substitute.

places.name: Cahirciveen
places.quote: That it is held necessary to free the feet of the corpse is shown by what happened once in Cahirciveen.

places.name: Killarney
places.quote: The wife went one day to Killarney, where she met the gossip.
